rubrics.question: Is `outputs/urban_heat_resilience_memo.md` at least 700 words and no more than 1000 words?
Does the memo include the exact title `Three-Summer Urban Heat Resilience Plan`?
Does the memo include all five exact headings: `Executive Summary`, `Risk Prioritization`, `Interventions`, `Measurement Plan`, and `Equity and Implementation Risks`?
Does the memo name all three priority neighborhoods: `Riverside`, `East Market`, and `South Junction`?
Does the memo include tree canopy as an intervention?
Does the memo include cool roofs as an intervention?
Does the memo include shade structures as an intervention?
Does the memo include cooling centers as an intervention?
Does the measurement plan include land surface temperature?
Does the measurement plan include emergency calls?
Does the measurement plan include cooling center visits?
Does the measurement plan include tree survival rate?
Does the measurement plan include resident-reported heat stress?
Does the memo include Year 1, Year 2, and Year 3 actions?
Does the memo claim that tree planting alone solves heat risk?
